How we chose the fixes (2026 weeks 1–5)

The same five weeks, run five ways. A caps picks at one per player and two per game. B skips players with fewer than 3 games for their current team. C averages six picker versions instead of trusting one.

Read this before betting

  • Each week only learned from earlier weeks, but the picker setup and the three fixes were chosen after looking at these same seasons. Treat the records as the best case. Week 6 on is the clean test.
  • Parlay payouts assume FanDuel pays the two prices multiplied, which it does for legs from different games. Real boosts are capped in stake and count.
  • The 2026 files only carry receptions, receiving yards, rush yards and pass yards.
  • Heavy-favourite unders (−180 and worse) win often but pay little; units show the money, the record shows the hit rate.
